classified_object.notes: Governed match under IFAB Laws; optional VAR treated as adjunct, not definitional.

performance_agency.summary: Player skill and team performance materially determine match outcomes.

performance_interface.summary: Primary interface is the human body with conventional equipment mediation.

embodied_performance.summary: Primary interface is the human body with conventional equipment mediation. Migrated as Embodied Performance; demand types are provisional.

arena.summary: Physical pitch with rule-bearing lines and goal geometry.

distributed_arena_relation.synchronization_mechanism: Human and optional officiating systems share match time and event state.
distributed_arena_relation.calibration_equivalence: Pitch and equipment conditions are governed by the Laws.
distributed_arena_relation.officiation_relation: Officials operate in the same contest environment.
distributed_arena_relation.safety_relation: One event safety authority governs the venue.

sensing_tracking.summary: Primarily human perception; optional video/tracking systems in some competitions.

measurement.summary: Goals, time, cards, and competition standings are standardized.

comparability.summary: Comparability within competition frameworks; pitch and condition variation bounded by Laws.

officiation.summary: Human refereeing central; technology may assist in some competitions.

outcome_openness.summary: Result emerges through performance within Laws, not a fixed script.

consequence_structure.summary: Competitive result, ranking effects, and physical cost are non-trivial.

operational_spatial_integration.summary: Computational systems may assist officiation but do not make the contest a Spatial Athletic System by default.

source_provisional_finding.summary: Baseline conventional athletic contest; reference positive for sport invariants and negative for Spatial Sport by default.

content: Competitions where computational geometry jointly constrains or officiates a unified physical-computational contest.

evidence_sources.source_title: Laws of the Game application materials

record.provenance_note: Per-field claim_class and status preserved verbatim from the source case. source_provisional_finding is the corpus's own attributed reading, not a new Atlas verdict. Provider claims live in evidence_sources; Altis interpretation carries C4/C5.
